generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The call `indexRequest.setPipeline(requestPipeline)` is redundant because `requestPipeline` was just retrieved from the same object via `indexRequest.getPipeline()`. This can be simplified to only call `setPipeline` in the `else` block.

review_comment: In the spirit of https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/116031/files#r1826153821, I'd like this PR a lot more if this record *didn't* become `public`.
